test_title: PYST 64: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence in which the ‘-ing’ form of verb expresses the continuity of an action/event.

options.text: Reading novels is my favourite pastime.
I am fond of reading science fiction.
Please do not disturb me. I am preparing for exams.
The optician advised me to use reading glasses.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the continuous form of the verb 'preparing' is used correctly.
 
• The sentence "I am preparing for exams" uses the **continuous form** of the verb to indicate an ongoing action.
 
• Therefore, the -ing form in this context represents the continuity of an action.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Please do not disturb me. I am **preparing** for exams*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **continuous form** of verbs, also known as the **progressive form**, is used to indicate actions that are ongoing at the moment of speaking.
 
• It is formed using the verb 'to be' in the appropriate tense followed by the -ing form of the main verb.
 
 
• **Example:** *I am **reading** a book right now.*
